expected_symptoms: checkout_db connection pool saturation (100/100 active connections)
Database query timeout errors in checkout-service logs
High 5xx error rate alert on checkout-service

ground_truth.root_cause: Deployment of checkout-service version v2.15.0 introduced an N+1 database query pattern in item discount calculation, exhausting the checkout_db connection pool and causing query timeouts and cascading HTTP 5xx errors.

causal_chain.explanation: Deployment v2.15.0 introduced itemized discount calculations executing query-in-loop per cart item
Discount query volume against checkout_db surged 10x per checkout summary request
Active connections against checkout_db saturated the pool capacity limit of 100 connections
Connection acquisition blocked and timed out after 5000ms threshold
checkout-service p95 latency spiked from 110ms to >3500ms due to connection acquisition timeouts
Cascading timeouts returned HTTP 504 and HTTP 500 error responses to api-gateway
checkout-service 5xx error rate exceeded 5% threshold, firing a critical alert
